meta.description: P4 (D-142) authored stand-ins: a modern country (geo) whose Gapminder 1900 record lacks life expectancy, total fertility or under-5 mortality, or whose values are rejected, takes the whole record of the named proxy geo. Provisional; confidence low. Crude birth rate targets follow the same rule.
meta.rule: A geo is used only when lex, tfr and u5mr are all present and it is not listed here; partial records are never mixed with a proxy's values.
